Murrieta Courthouse

Address: 30755-D Auld Road, Murrieta, Ca. 92563

Phone: 951-704-7634

Murrieta Courthouse is situated in Murrieta at30755-D Auld Road, and it serves the area of Murrieta, riverside, and its surrounding. The courthouse consists of a superior court and a southwest justice center. The court handles criminal, traffic, civil, juvenile, small claims, and detainer criminal cases. It's a jam-packed court; many issues were heard and solved, so reach court before the time; otherwise, you need to wait a little longer.

People Also See: Kern County

Murrieta Courthouse Case Search:

Murrieta Courthouse Case Search can be done by

  • Searching by name
  • Searching by case number
  • Searching by address
  • Searching by phone
  • Searching by email

Some recorded information is confidential and is not found online. For these types of records, a person had to submit an open record request to the clerk's office. Download and fill in all the information on the form and send it to the court clerk's office. The court will then decide whether to provide you with that record information or not.

Southwest Courthouse:

Southwest Courthouse Murrieta ca is the justice center in the Murrieta courthouse. It hears and solves criminal, civil, traffic, small claims, eviction, and juvenile cases. Its working hours are from 7:30 to 4:00 pm from Monday to Friday. Jail Facility and Riverside County Sheriff's Office is situated at the complex so that time is safe and county cost are reduced. This court is very busy, so come with your attorney before the time; otherwise, your case hearing would be late. If you have a case in southwest court, then appear with an experienced attorney. It also contains a southwest valley youth court developed to give positive alternative sanctions to an offender for the first time by providing a peer-driven sentencing mechanism that lets young people take responsibility and restitution.

see also The Dickenson County Courthouse

Murrieta Eviction Court:

Murrieta Eviction Court hears and solves the eviction cases. Suppose you are involved in an eviction, then first understand all the legal rights and then hire a professional eviction lawyer. The process to take your property back, and the renter refuses or does not pay the rent, then send them a notice of leaving. If they do not agree to go, then file an unlawful detainer lawsuit at the Murrieta Superior Court.

How to make payments?

Murrieta Court pay ticket can be done in the following ways:

In-Person

A Person can make payment by visiting the court during business hours.

Online

A Person can make payment using the online system. The courthouse accepts all online methods. This court has a payCity that allows paying a traffic ticket online.

Mail

A Person can pay by sending a check to the court's mailing address. The court's mailing address is 1 Town Square Murrieta, California 92562

Murrieta Family Law

Murrieta Family Law gives all the information about child custody, divorce, family matters, etc. The cases are heard and solved according to family law. Suppose you are in a family case, then contact a family law facilitator lawyer that works in a superior court. They will give you all the information according to the law.

Murrieta Divorce Court

Murrieta Divorce Court cases are heard and solved by the family court. A petition and summons are filled if someone wants to file a divorce case. After filing all the necessary forms and paying the fee, the case number is given to you in the family law courthouse. If the other party does not provide an answer, you get a divorce by default judgment. You can ask the court to arrange a mandatory settlement conference and then trial if there is some financial disclosure.

Murrieta Traffic Court

Murrieta Traffic Court hears and solves cases related to speed and other traffic-related matters. The southwest justice center contains traffic court cases. The ticket costs depend on the rate you drive or the rules you are breaking. For example, for a speed of 1-15 Mph, the fine is $280.

Murrieta Juvenile Court

Murrieta Juvenile Court was handed by the southwest justice center. A person who had committed a California Juvenile offense is arrested and is presented in this court for the case. That person will give a punishment if the issue is minor or if the case is not little, then sentence punishment is given. Facilities provided to the juvenile case persons are loved ones can visit or call them, Medical facilities, etc.

Murrieta Courthouse Marriage

Murrieta Courthouse marriage licenses are given by the clerk's office from 8:00 am to 4:30 pm five days a week. The couple's age must be 18+, and both are available in the court on time. The fee for a marriage license is $90. A photo ID like Driver's License or Passport must be required for marriage. The ceremony will be held in court by the family law judges.

FAQ:

How many Eviction notices will be given to a party?

Four Eviction notices are given to the party if they are not leaving the property, and these are:

  • Notice of pay rent or quit the place in 3 days
  • Notice to quit or vacate in 30 days
  • Notice to stop or go in 60 days
  • Note according to Section 8 of 90 days eviction

How many courthouses are in Murrieta?

Courthouses in Murrieta are Superior court and Southwest Justice Center.

What is Murrieta Traffic Court Phone Number?

Murrieta Traffic Court Phone Number is (951) 461-6301 and (951) 304-2677.

What is Murrieta Riverside Court?

Murrieta Riverside Court is near the southwest justice center court, where probate and traffic cases are heard and solved.

What is the website link for Murrieta Courthouse?

Murrieta Courthouse's website is https://www.murrietaca.gov/528/Riverside-County-Courts.

What is the dress code for Murrieta Courthouse?

Murrieta Courthouse's dress code is rigorous. Clean and decent shirts with shoes are allowed. Short, loose tops, sleeveless shirts, and sandals are not permitted in the court. An attorney recommends dressing appropriately and wearing a suit.

How to see the jobs in Murrieta Courthouse?

Murrieta Courthouse jobs can be found on the career page of the courthouse website.
